Hi Professor Alvarez — I need to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these free slots:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Would one of those work for you? Happy to take another time if none of these fit.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Does Monday 14:00-14:30 work for you? If not, I could also do Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Happy to fit whatever is free on your side.

Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23–27). My free slots that week are:

- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30
- Wed Nov 25, 15:00–15:30

Monday 10:00-10:30 works — let's take it. I've put our 1:1 on my calendar for next week, so it's booked. See you then.
Monday 14:00-14:30 works — booked. Our 1:1 is on my calendar for next week. See you then.
Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works — let's take it. I've booked our 1:1 on my calendar for next week. See you then.
Tuesday 11:00-11:30 works — booked. Our 1:1 is on my calendar for next week. See you then.

Thanks, Sarah. Both of those are taken on my side, I'm afraid — Monday 10:00 now has another 1:1 and Thursday 14:00-14:30 falls inside my PhD student 1:1 and curriculum committee blocks. Could you do Wednesday 10:00-10:30 or Thursday 10:00-10:30 instead? Tell me which and I'll book it.
Perfect, thank you — Monday 14:00-14:30 is on my calendar too. See you then.
Perfect — Monday 10:00-10:30 it is. I've put it on my calendar too. See you then!
Perfect, thank you — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 it is, on my calendar too. See you then.

Thanks for the quick reply. Both of those clash on my side: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is inside my CSE455 office hours (10:00-11:30) and Thursday 10:00-10:30 is my CSE444 focus block (10:00-10:50).

My free 30-minute slots next week are:
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Any of those work for you? Tell me which and I'll note it (or book it, if you'd rather I do it).
Perfect — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is on my calendar too. See you then!
Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is free on my side — booked. Our 1:1 is on my calendar for next week. See you then.
Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works — booked. Our 1:1 is on my calendar for next week (Nov 25). See you then.

Thanks for the details, Sarah. Monday 14:00-14:30 and Tuesday 11:00-11:30 have gone to other 1:1s in the meantime, and Friday 11:00-11:30 falls inside my paper-review block, so none of your three works for me, I'm afraid.

The only free 30 minutes I still have next week are Wednesday 10:00-10:30 (taken now by another 1:1), Wednesday 13:00-13:30 (also taken) and Thursday 10:00-10:30 — and you say your CSE444 focus block runs then. Could you shift that focus block, or offer me another free slot? Working hours only, Monday to Friday 09:00-17:00.

Perfect, thank you — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 it is. It's on my calendar and logged. See you then.

— Omar
Great — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is on my calendar too. See you then, Professor.
Thursday 10:00-10:30 works for me — I'll shift my CSE444 focus block around it. Please go ahead and book it. Thanks!

Correction and a better offer, Sarah: I do still have Wednesday 15:00-15:30 free next week, and you listed that as free too. Shall we take it? If yes, I'll put it on my calendar and it's booked — no need to move your focus block.
Booked: Thursday 10:00-10:30. It's on my calendar and logged. (Ignore my previous note about Wednesday 15:00-15:30 — our messages crossed; Thursday stands.) See you then.
Perfect — Thursday 10:00-10:30 it is, and it's on my calendar too. I'll shift my CSE444 focus block to 10:30-10:50 that morning. See you then!
All settled — our 1:1 is Thursday 10:00-10:30 next week, on my calendar and logged.
Great — it's on mine too. See you Thursday at 10:00.
